answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 157552 Country: INDIA Title: Is it permissible to perform salah in front of mirror? Question: Is it permissible to perform salah in front of mirror? Answer ID: 157552 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 467/385/B=4/1439) It is lawful, Salah will be valid. But it is better to cover it with curtain so that you can avoid seeing the reflection of yourself or others in the mirror. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
